column1:
Showers or thundershowers are likely at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Colombo to Matara via Galle during the evening or night.

Winds will be easterly to northeasterly. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to 40 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be moderate at
times. The other sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
